problem_context.problem_statement: Verify CalculateGyroDgFun end-to-end with QCP/Rocq. The function initializes tmpwa[0..4] to 0, copies JoinTotal selected gyroscope samples wa[SignFlag[j]] into tmpwa[j], and when JoinTotal >= 3 delegates a 3x5 by 5x1 matrix multiplication to compute W[0..2]; otherwise it sets W[0..2] to 0. Missing IP.h/MatrixMulti.h must be bootstrapped from the C semantics rather than treated as a terminal blocker.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Memory-safe execution; tmpwa initialized; for 0 <= j < JoinTotal selected wa values are copied according to SignFlag; if JoinTotal < 3 then W[0..2] are float zero; if JoinTotal >= 3 then W represents Rtemp multiplied by the five-element tmpwa vector under the approved MatrixMulti call specification.
problem_context.input_output_contract: pIp and pGyroData are valid; JoinTotal <= 5; every SignFlag index read for j < JoinTotal is < 9; arrays have declared extents; only W[0..2] is externally modified by this function, subject to the MatrixMulti call contract.
spec_hint: Use predicate-first loop invariants for the zero-initialization and gather loops. Model the MatrixMulti call through an annotation-approved mathematical call specification; do not mirror the C algorithm as a new Rocq recursive function.
preferred_hidden_properties: tmpwa prefix initialization and prefix gather relation: initialized suffix remains zero and gathered prefix equals wa indexed by SignFlag; final W is either zero vector or the matrix-vector product.
forbidden_patterns: Do not use QCP_demos_human; do not encode a second copy of the C loops as a Rocq algorithm; do not leave the external call unconstrained.
reference_case_hints: Use only QCP_demos_LLM or verified engineering cases with predicate-first annotations and call specifications.
